actor_report:
Observations: schema/orders.schema.json is now version 2 and requires [id, amount, currency]. V1's basis was version 1, so V1 is stale and cannot count as a current pass (FOUNDATIONS Workspace and context; RF-005 Exact Basis). In data/orders.json, both items ({id:1, amount:12.5} and {id:2, amount:8}) lack "currency". schema/customers.schema.json is still version 1, and both customer items have id and email.

Work: I re-evaluated both subjects against the current workspace by manual inspection. The schemas use only array/object type and `required` keys, so inspection decides them. No validator or command was run. I added V3 as a new result on the version 2 basis instead of overwriting V1, because a new result on a different basis does not overwrite the earlier one (Result algebra). V1 is annotated as stale and superseded. I annotated V2 as re-checked and still current. I set Gate to blocked, because the checklist requires every record to be a current pass and V3 is falsified. This records the gate state only. It is not a release acceptance.

Unresolved: whether to fix the orders data (add currency) or change the schema is outside this grant. data/ and schema/ may not be edited, and the choice belongs to their owner (RF-006; SPEC_METHOD Computed Classification: candidate behavior cannot author its own target law). The checks rely on manual inspection, not a validator run. A tool-based run, if the release requires one, is still outstanding. The file effects are proposals only; the host's application is not observed by me.
